system.description:
You manifest a potent but powerful sense of spite or hatred in the form of illusionary chakra, and impose it on a hostile creature you can see in range who has just gained a rank of either a Mental or Sensory condition, that can have more than 1 rank.

The target creature must make an Intelligence saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s negative effects.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s negative effects but takes 2d6 psychic damage.

Failure: Affected creatures gains 1 additional rank of the same condition and takes 3d6 psychic damage.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the target instead gains 2 additional ranks of the same condition and takes 5d6 psychic damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by +1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher increase ranks of conditions inflicted by +1.
